brief: The official site is live (HTTP 200) and serving “CUPI Cornell | Cornell Physical Intelligence.” On a search snapshot from Aug 21, 2026 · 12:50 PM EDT — not Google Search Console — cornellphysicalintelligence.com ranks in 12 of 20 tracked queries, averaging position 2.5 where it appears, and is missing from the other 8. The short queries are the problem: Campus Groups take the #1 slot on the names people actually type. The wiki is not in the top results for any tracked query. The public page is a Google login wall, so there is nothing for a crawler to index.
